name: Puncturing Fangs adds 3 Rage to Bloodmoon Blast (#964)
contract: Puncturing Fangs 804604 is one effect: aura 107 with MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, which Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers maps to effect index 1) and BasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30, over EffectSpellClassMask (0, 8192, 0) = word 1 bit 13 = the ten Bloodmoon Blast records (500125, 501607-501614, 572332). Bloodmoon Blast's effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (142) with value 50, forwarded by Spell::EffectTriggerSpell as the base points of 804092, whose effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE with MiscValue 1 (POWER_RAGE). Rage is stored at ten times the displayed value, so 50 -> 80 is 5 Rage -> 8 Rage. Tooltip: "Your Bloodmoon Blast now generates 3 additional Rage per hit." Regression guard for native behaviour.

steps.label: Bloodmoon Blast forwards its authored 50 before the talent
Puncturing Fangs raises the forwarded energize to 80 (8 Rage)
Puncturing Fangs does not touch Bloodbolt
